content: @firebase/rules-unit-testing (v5.x) is the official package for mocking Auth and testing Firestore Security Rules against the Local Emulator Suite; commonly paired with Vitest (v4.x, up from documented v2.x examples) with extended timeouts (~30s) for emulator startup. firebase-admin (v14.x) and firebase-functions (v7.x, Node >=18) are used for Cloud Functions integration tests against the same emulators.
